story.title: The Last Door

panels.desc: A windy evening at the very end of the Pair Forest. The path ends at two tall trees, and between them hangs a huge patchwork quilt like a curtain, flapping in the wind; on the quilt the two letters q and u are stitched — the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Leaves whirl. Bun holds her floppy ear down; Hedgie hugs a tree; Pip says the two letters in the wrong order; Pim and Pam cling to each other. A duck's head pokes out under the edge of the quilt, beak wide open, quacking. Hidden in the picture: the quilt, the quacking duck.
panels.ko: 바람 부는 저녁, 숲의 맨 끝. 두 나무 사이에 q·u 가 수놓인 커다란 누비이불이 커튼처럼 펄럭여요. 이불 밑에서 "꽥!"

panels.desc: Pim and Pam say the sound together and the big quilt lifts up like a stage curtain. Behind it, the Duck King and a row of ducks quack happily, and there stands the last door of the forest: a tall round wooden door in a wall of roots, with the two letters w and h carved on it — together with q and u on the quilt, these are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Its knocker is a big silver kitchen whisk, and a little rope whip hangs on a hook beside it. A small cheetah cub dashes past with speed lines. Beads clicks four beads. Hidden in the picture: the quilt, the quacking ducks, the whisk, the whip, the quick cheetah cub. (The little king is the Duck King: a small yellow duck with a tiny golden crown — an animal, not a human.)
panels.ko: 핌과 팜이 /kw/! 이불이 무대 막처럼 올라가요. 뒤에는 꽥꽥 오리들과 w·h 가 새겨진 마지막 문! 문고리는 커다란 거품기예요.

panels.desc: The wind dies down. Pip flies up to the last door alone, takes a deep breath and says the sound by itself on the very first try, knocking with the big silver whisk; Pim and Pam, Bun, Hedgie and Beads stand behind it cheering together. The last door bursts open and golden light pours out over the friends. Hidden in the picture: the whisk, the whip on its hook, the quilt.
panels.ko: 바람이 멎었어요. 핍이 혼자 마지막 문 앞에 날아가 거품기 문고리를 두드리며 "/w/ /w/ whisk!" 한 번에 말해요. 문이 활짝 열리고 금빛이 쏟아져요.

panels.desc: Behind the last door is a quiet round glade. A single big glowing golden music note rises from the grass and floats into Pip, who stands on a stump singing with its beak wide open and little golden notes streaming out. Grumble has come down from the trees and stands with the friends; with his eyes closed and a paw on his heart he hums along; Pim and Pam sing beside Pip; Bun and Hedgie hold paws; Beads sways; the ducks quack along and a white feather quill drifts down; the cheetah cub dashes in circles. Hidden in the picture: the quacking ducks, the feather quill, the quilt, the quick cheetah cub.
panels.ko: 마지막 문 너머, 풀밭에서 금빛 음표가 솟아 핍에게 들어가요. 노래 조각 셋! 핍이 노래하고, 내려온 그럼블도 눈을 감고 따라 흥얼거려요.

story.synopsis_ko: 숲의 맨 끝, 커다란 누비이불이 바람에 펄럭여요. 핌과 팜이 /kw/! 이불이 올라가자 꽥꽥 오리들과 마지막 문이 나타나요. 핍이 혼자 "/w/ /w/ whisk!" — 마지막 문이 열리고 노래 조각 셋이 핍에게 들어가요. 그럼블도 눈을 감고 따라 흥얼거려요.
story.so_far_ko: 침팬지에게 램프를 주고 그럼블의 등불을 되찾았어요.
story.goal_ko: wh·qu 를 말해 숲의 마지막 문을 열고 노래 조각 셋을 찾아요.
